顾承安关闭成像界面，拿着排号单走到三号窗口，把银行卡和身份证从窗口下方的凹槽推进去。

“取现，五万。”

柜台里面的姑娘接过证件看了一眼，在电脑上操作了几下，然后抬头问了一句：“您好先生，请问您取这笔现金的用途是什么？”

顾承安之前在网上没少刷到这类吐槽，什么“我取自己的钱还要汇报用途”之类的段子，当时看着觉得挺乐，心说至于吗。

现在轮到自己了，才知道那感觉确实有那么一点微妙。

不过他也理解，这是银行的反诈反洗钱流程，人家也是按规矩办事。

“做点小批发生意，进货和日常周转用的，习惯备点现金。”

理由合理，柜员也没多问，核实完信息之后就开始点钞。

几分钟后，五沓崭新的百元钞票从窗口推了出来，柜员细心地用两个信封分装好。

“请您清点一下。”

顾承安随手翻了翻，没细数，收好东西道了声谢，转身离开柜台。

两叠信封不算厚，但也塞不进裤兜。他索性一手拎着，往大门方向走。

走了几步，他感觉到了。

身后有人跟上来了。

顾承安没有回头。

他继续往前走，出了银行大门，走到车门边，他抬手按了一下钥匙，借着拉车门的动作，他微微侧了下身。

余光里，跟在后面的人正是那个灰色夹克大叔，刘建国。

距离他大概五六米远，站在那里，右手还是插在口袋里，脸上的表情比刚才在大厅里更纠结，像是在做什么艰难的抉择。

顾承安心里叹了口气。

他把车门又关上了。

转身，直接朝刘建国走过去。

刘建国明显没料到这一出，身体本能地往后退了半步，眼里闪过一丝慌乱，但随即又硬撑着站住了。

顾承安在他面前站定，语气很平常，就像在问路一样：“大叔，有事吗？我看你从里面就一直在看我。”

他没说“跟着”，说的是“看”。

刘建国张了张嘴，视线躲闪了一下：“没……没事。”

顾承安看着他，换了个更柔和的语气：“大叔，你是不是碰上什么难处了？没事，你跟我说，我要是能帮上忙，就帮一把。”

刘建国怔住了。

他完全没有预料到对方会说出这样的话，他站在原地，嘴唇哆嗦了两下，想说什么又说不出来。

然后，毫无征兆地，这个四十七岁的中年男人蹲了下去，双手捂着脸，肩膀剧烈抖动。

压抑的哭声像是积攒了太久太久终于兜不住了。

Gu Chengan closed the imaging interface, walked to window three with the queue sheet, and pushed his bank card and ID card through the groove below the window.

"Withdraw cash, fifty thousand."

The girl at the counter took the certificate and took a look at it, did a few operations on the computer, then raised her head and asked: "Hello sir, what is the purpose of withdrawing this cash?"

Gu Chengan had seen this kind of complaints on the Internet a lot before, such as "I withdraw my own money and I still have to report the use" and other jokes. At the time, I thought it was quite funny, and I thought it was okay.

Now it was my turn, and I realized that the feeling was indeed a little subtle.

However, he also understood that this was the bank's anti-fraud and anti-money laundering procedures, and they also followed the rules.

"Do some small wholesale business, use it for purchasing goods and daily turnover, and get used to keeping some cash."

The reason was reasonable, and the teller didn't ask any questions. After verifying the information, he started counting the money.

A few minutes later, five wads of brand-new hundred-dollar bills were pushed out of the window, and the teller carefully packed them in two envelopes.

"Please take stock."

Gu Chengan flipped through it casually without counting it in detail. He put the things away and thanked him before turning and leaving the counter.

The two stacks of envelopes are not too thick, but they cannot be stuffed into a trouser pocket.He simply carried it with one hand and walked towards the door.

After walking a few steps, he felt it.

Someone followed behind me.

Gu Chengan didn't look back.

He continued to walk forward, walked out of the bank gate, and walked to the car door. He raised his hand and pressed the key. He turned slightly sideways by pulling the car door.

From the corner of his eye, he saw that the man following him was none other than the man in the gray jacket, Liu Jianguo.

About five or six meters away from him, he stood there with his right hand still in his pocket. The expression on his face was more complicated than in the hall just now, as if he was making a difficult decision.

Gu Chengan sighed inwardly.

He closed the car door again.

Turn around and walk directly towards Liu Jianguo.

Liu Jianguo obviously did not expect this, and his body instinctively took half a step back. A trace of panic flashed in his eyes, but then he stood firm again.

Gu Chengan stood still in front of him and spoke in a normal tone, as if he was asking for directions: "Uncle, what's the matter? I see you've been looking at me from inside."

He didn't say "follow", he said "look".

Liu Jianguo opened his mouth and dodges his eyes: "No...it's okay."

Gu Chengan looked at him and changed his tone to a softer tone: "Uncle, are you encountering any difficulties? It's okay. Just tell me. If I can help, I will help."

Liu Jianguo was stunned.

He didn't expect the other party to say such words at all. He stood there, his lips trembling twice, and he couldn't say what he wanted to say.

Then, without warning, the forty-seven-year-old middle-aged man squatted down, covering his face with his hands, and his shoulders shook violently.

The suppressed crying seemed to have accumulated for too long and finally could no longer be contained.
